messages:
Emily Chen: Quick sync — we need final decisions on trainer handoffs and lab kit shipment for SI bootcamp next month. Who's coordinating trainer slides + hardware packing list? :package:

Raj Patel: I'll own the trainer slides. ETA EOD Tuesday. Do we have a canonical slide deck template? @Ava Kim

Ava Kim: Use the "SI-bootcamp-template-v2.pptx" in Drive. I'll add a trainer notes tab. Also adding shadowing checklist.

Diego Morales: I'll run the lab kit packing. Need final HW list + firmware versions. Is it OK to include a small GPU dongle + NVMe? :truck: 

Sara Li: Firmware versions: build 2.14.3 for NVMe, v1.9 for dongles. Also need per-kit test script. @OnboardBot can you attach latest validation script?

OnboardBot: Attached: validate_labkit.sh (sha256: abc123...). Run on first boot: 
```
./validate_labkit.sh --selftest --report=pdf
```

Ava Kim: Nice. Diego — here's minimal packing manifest I drafted:
```
- RTX 4060 dongle x1
- 1TB NVMe (preloaded images) x1
- Ethernet dongle x1
- Power adapter + regional plug x1
- Preconfigured USB with onboarding scripts x1
- Quickstart laminated card x1
```

Diego Morales: Good list. Question — do we ship pre-imaged with model weights? Legal flagged model redistribution. Sara, is it allowed under our SI agreement?

Sara Li: Legal: we can ship inference binaries + sample weights (100MB subset) under current SI MSA; full model weights require customer license. I'll send amendment language to include in packing slip.

Emily Chen: Great. Also need trainer certification checklist and scoring rubric. Raj, can your slides include a 10-min certification quiz? We want pass/fail + retake policy.

Raj Patel: Yep. Proposed rubric: 60% hands-on, 40% quiz; passing = 70%. Add a 'trainer assessment' checkbox for lead SE. I'll push slides and attach quiz Google Form by Wed.

Ava Kim: For remote participants, we need proctoring notes and shared lab endpoints. Ops — can we allocate 8 dedicated pre-warmed instances for the hands-on labs during the week? @ops

Operations (ops): We can reserve 8 dedicated nodes in us-west-2 for the week. Need start/end times and expected concurrency. Billing will be moved to partnerships cost center.

Emily Chen: Dates: June 8-10, 9am–5pm PDT. Concurrency peak ~40 (4 users per node). Please set autoscale policy: min 8, max 12.

Operations (ops): Done — autoscale policy created. We'll also attach SSO onboarding link for trainers.

Diego Morales: Shipping timeline — I can drop off to fulfillment on May 28 to arrive by June 5. Need final packing labels and commercial invoices.

Sara Li: I'll draft invoice template and include limited-model clause. Emily, can you approve by Friday?

Emily Chen: Approved. Thanks all. Quick TODOs:
- Raj: slides + quiz form (by Wed)
- Ava: finalize trainer notes + checklist (by Tue)
- Diego: confirm packing & drop-off (May 28)
- Sara: legal amendment & invoices (by Fri)
- Ops: infra reservation (done)

Ava Kim: I'll also create a short trainer onboarding channel and post 'trainer-oncall' schedule.

Raj Patel: One more Q — certification badges? Do we issue digital badges or just certificates PDF?

Emily Chen: Digital badges via Credly would be great, but start with PDF certs. Partnerships will scope Credly integration in Q3.

Diego Morales: All set from my side. Shipping label draft incoming.

Emily Chen: Thanks team! :tada:
